name: AddDirectionalGroup

parameters.help_en:
The name of the directional group.

The group name supports Chinese characters, English letters, digits, and underscores (_), with a maximum length of 30 characters
parameters.help_zh:
给定向分组设置一个名称。

分组名称支持中文、英文、数字及下划线（_），长度不超过30个字符
parameters.name: group_name

Others: The call fails. For more information about error codes, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en:
The directional group ID.

Record the directional group ID. You need to specify the directional group ID when you call other API operations later. For example, when you call the [AddDirectionalCard]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446808.html） operation to import IoT cards into the directional group, you need to specify the directional group ID
Data.description_zh:

请记录定向分组ID，后续调用其他接口，例如调用[AddDirectionalCard]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446808.html）给定向分组里导入物联网卡时需填入定向分组ID
